name: Forty Five
summary: A trick-taking game where the trump suit has a unique ranking and players score for winning tricks toward 45 points.
rules_text: Deal 5 cards to each player (3 then 2) and turn the next card for trump. The holder of the ace of trump may swap any card from hand for the upcard; if they decline they must have dealer turn it down, revealing they hold the ace. If the upcard is an ace, the dealer may take it after first trick or announce playing without it. Ace of hearts is always third-best trump. In trump, 5 is high, then J, ace of hearts, A of trump, etc.; red suits rank A high in plain suits except hearts where A is low, black suits rank A low in plain suits but 2 low. Left of dealer leads. Must follow suit if possible or trump if unable. If a low trump is led you need not play 5, J, or ace of hearts. Highest trump wins trumped tricks, otherwise highest of led suit wins. Winner leads next. 3-4 tricks scores 5, 5 tricks scores 10; variant scores 5 per trick with net difference; first to 45 wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with unusual trump ranking, strategic bidding and play
